_note: Machine-readable code tables for Habbo Wired / G-Presets JSON. Confidence: V=verified in game or by user export, I=inferred, U=unverified.

comparison_codes.confidence: V (user export of six conditions in UI order; also used by selectors in field options[0])

variable_scope_codes.2: selector mode flag, not a scope (see selectors)

furni_source_codes.100: furni picked in the dialog (items list)

user_source_codes.200: users output by a selector (or forwarded users, depending on the effect)

change_variable_operations.50: random with upper bound (V: returns 0..value-1; endpoint exclusivity not formally proven)
change_variable_operations.60: absolute value (I; test input was bad, U)
change_variable_operations.103: bitwise NOT (V: NOT 5 = -6, values are signed 32-bit)
change_variable_operations.111: next LOW bit inclusive (next 0 bit at index >= value, -1 if none)
change_variable_operations.112: next HIGH bit inclusive (next 1 bit at index >= value)
change_variable_operations.113: previous LOW bit inclusive (previous 0 bit at index <= value)
change_variable_operations.114: previous HIGH bit inclusive (previous 1 bit at index <= value)
change_variable_operations._low_high: LOW means a 0 bit, HIGH means a 1 bit. Results are bit indices, -1 when none.
change_variable_operations.confidence: V for all listed except 60 and 105

wf_act_change_var_val.delay: effect delay (unit I: 0.5 s per step)

wf_act_give_var.note: A variable must be GIVEN before it can be changed or selected on. Give with override=1 acts as 'create or assign'.

wf_slc_users_with_var / wf_slc_furni_wit.mode: 0 = just 'has the variable' (value ignored; dialog shows Select-by-value unticked), 1 = select by value compared with the literal in options[3], 2 = select by value compared with the variable named in variableIds[1]
wf_slc_users_with_var / wf_slc_furni_wit.flags: separate JSON booleans 'filter' (Filter existing selection) and 'inverse' (Invert)
wf_slc_users_with_var / wf_slc_furni_wit.evidence: V: '!u0..!u8' and '!f1/!f2' calibration runs + user's operand.json export (options [0,1,0,1010101010,1,0] shows '<' literal 1010101010 in the dialog)

wf_act_send_signal.furniSources: [antennaSource (100 = use picked furnis), furniToForward (0 = triggering item, 200 = selector output)]
wf_act_send_signal.note: Writing 0 in furniSources[0] makes the antenna come from the triggering item and the signal goes nowhere. V (user fixed this in game).

wf_xtra_text_input_variable.config: placeholder name used as #(name) in the trigger text
wf_xtra_text_input_variable.note: V (user + Shop + Cherb exports): the capturer can only write to a context variable. Copy it to a user/furni variable with an effect if you need persistence.

wf_var_context.variableId: '' in real exports; the numeric id lives in wired.variables_map. Tick 'Has Value'.

wf_xtra_text_output_variable.config: placeholder name, used as $(name) in messages
wf_xtra_text_output_variable.note: Set 'Variable display type' to Textual to show text from a Text Connector.

wf_trg_periodically.note: copied from Shop; I: 2 = every 1 s (0.5 s units), U

wf_trg_var_changed.event_codes: seen: 3, 4, 7. I: 3 given/created, 4 removed, 7 any change. The UI also offers update/increase/decrease/unchanged; exact codes U.

wf_act_call_stacks.items: [trigger furni of the stack to run]
wf_act_call_stacks.note: Subroutine call without signals (Cherb record 343). Semantics U.

stack_heights_z.note: from user's claude_info.json; stack z values must follow real heights
